hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A combined lending AMM hook that manages a shared full-range Uniswap v4 LP position. LPs deposit ETH/token liquidity; borrowers pledge token collateral (40% LTV) to receive ETH loans; liquidators repay underwater positions. The hook collects a protocol swap fee via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns and blocks external swaps in any block containing a liquidation.
